hypotheses.binder: (hJ : Ideal.map (algebraMap R B) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) ≤ (Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal B)))
hypotheses.justification: Replace the auxiliary unit-selection argument by finite avoidance over R. Using IsLocalRing.residue_surjective, choose representatives t(a) of the infinite residue field. For distinct a,b, t(a)-t(b) is a unit by IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit. Consequently, finitely many nonzero R-linear maps on W are simultaneously nonzero: inductively, take y avoiding the previous kernels and x outside the next kernel, then choose y+t(a)•x. Each map excludes at most one parameter unless it vanishes on x, in which case a previously avoided map excludes none. Two excluded parameters would contradict IsUnit.smul_eq_zero. Apply this to the restrictions of P.asIdeal.mkQ.comp f for all maximal ideals P. As in the existing proof, hW and surjectivity of f ensure each restriction is nonzero. The selected f-value avoids every maximal ideal, hence is a unit by exists_max_ideal_of_mem_nonunits. The existing basis-update induction then applies without hJ. Empty families cause no problem: if B is the zero ring, every value is a unit; if s is empty, retain b.
